{{Top|leg}}
The '''Casino Line''' was a strip of [[Casino/Legends|casinos]] in the [[Westrex]] District of [[Efavan/Legends|Efavan]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vorzyd V/Legends|Vorzyd V]]. Two such casinos were the [[Hand Pot (casino)|Hand Pot]] and the [[Last Card]].
